answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to price identity through work, not price: every answer must include three rotating words and a real mechanism, then a jury of peers grades it. A farm copying one idea across many names gets little, because the garden of submissions is checked against prior ones, each fresh account is timber for the stake it must risk, and the tide of attestations only rises when peers countersign. Coordination becomes costly, impersonation loses.
